items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 94:1
items.html: For in truth Atik was corrected to be the root for the light of Hassadim, and AA to be the root for the light of Hochma. However this is only from the aspect of the division of the five Partzufim of Atzilut into twelve Partzufim. Then Atik bestows Hochma upon AA, to the root of its part from the chest and above, which stands in the Peh of AA, as is known. But Atik itself became the root for the light of Hassadim, and it bestows from the Yesod and above the aspect of covered Hassadim to AVI, as above in Inner Observation, Part 8. And when they are in this manner, AA too does not bestow Hochma, for all bestowal is from the aspect of the HGT of the Partzuf, and since its aspect of HGT is in covered Hassadim, how could it still bestow Hochma from it? Therefore, when AA wishes to bestow Hochma upon the Partzufim, it must become one Partzuf with Atik, at which time the HGT of AA become the aspect of the NHY of Atik, and it can then bestow the illumination of Hochma through them. And you must remember the rule stated above, that wherever NHY rise to HGT, the HGT itself becomes the aspect of revealed Hassadim.
